decisions.reason: This metro data-centre connectivity offer fits the firm's cloud and infrastructure strategy, and because it leverages owned network assets the option value of keeping it remains higher than the cost of carrying it.
Optical spectrum connectivity is closely aligned with the firm's high-bandwidth software-defined direction, so the product should be retained as a strategically valuable network option.

The voice number ordering portal is a modest-cost digital extension of the existing voice business, so management would keep it unless usage proves too limited to justify even its relatively low support burden.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony service with weak fit to the firm's forward path, and by now uncertainty is sufficiently resolved that resources are better reallocated to core and newer growth areas.

Direct voice network connection is nearer to the core than carrier pre-selection, but after several years its voice-centric standalone value is likely too limited relative to stronger infrastructure and cloud options.
